title: Filter labels on other reports read as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • At least three locations are open to you: {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}.
    For example: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, QA Testing and ZZAUTOTEST SSR Third Location.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Parts Velocity is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open a filter on the report that lets you tick several options (for example Location).
  2. Tick every option.
  3. Close the filter and read its label in the toolbar.
  4. Open the same filter again.
  5. Untick options until exactly two remain ticked.
  6. Close the filter and read its label in the toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the filter opens with its options.
  • Step 2: every option is ticked.
  • Step 3: the label reads "All" followed by the filter's own word, as before the release (for example "All locations").
  • Step 4: the filter opens again.
  • Step 5: two options are ticked.
  • Step 6: the label reads the count and the filter's own word, as before the release (for example "2 locations"); it does not list the two option names the way the new Sales Type filter does.
